essence: The verse recalls an earlier teaching about a particular moment in the heart.
The offering measure at Uddiyana is half the measure at Jalandhara.
Near Nilakantha, one should not engage in deliberation about the measure.
Great accomplishment arises within thirteen days.
At Radha and Vikataksha, accomplishment comes quickly.
